fields.supportsPdfDocumentBlockDescription: When enabled, Tinker lets the Read tool open PDF files and the SDK injects them as document content blocks. The Moonshot Anthropic-compatible endpoint (including the built-in Kimi channel) currently returns HTTP 500 for these blocks, so this toggle is off by default. Enable only for self-hosted reverse proxies or channels you have verified.
